answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 21244 Country: India Title: I need to know ruling about posting human (any other living being's) photo on web sites. As creating pictures of living being is wrong. Does the same ruling apply to posting photos on web sites. Mainly when the photo is used as Identity of the person on web site. Question: AssalamuAlaikum, May Allah bless you. I need to know ruling about posting human (any other living being's) photo on web sites. As creating pictures of living being is wrong. Does the same ruling apply to posting photos on web sites. Mainly when the photo is used as Identity of the person on web site. AssalamuAlaikum. Answer ID: 21244 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 720/585/B=1431) Yes, the same ruling would be applicable in posting photo on website. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
